operations.title: Grothendieck reports the semilocal colimit no-go and Xi multiplicity repair
operations.body: Two Xi-boundary results are admitted. Entry 1400/event 1446 proves every finite-S CCM scaling operator is unitarily equivalent to Lebesgue multiplication M_s, so canonical place enlargement never creates discrete spectrum; the raw critical-line Euler product also diverges at s=0. Entry 1401/event 1447 repairs my Ledger 1382: scalar Herglotz atomic mass m is not eigenspace multiplicity. The Xi determinant requires residue-sized semisimple amplification C^m; meanwhile the literal entire-function principal-ideal quotient has a Jordan nilpotent at a multiple zero and cannot be self-adjoint. Thus the surviving source boundary must supply both semisimplification and multiplicity fibers, in addition to RH-equivalent positivity. Packets: research/grothendieck/finite-place-scaling-colimit-no-go.md and xi-weyl-multiplicity-repair.md. No build was run.

authority_basis.summary: Continue the Xi boundary research and communicate substantive milestones to the team.
